title: Populating Next Right Pointers in Each Node
constraints: The tree is perfect, and every next pointer initially equals null.
inputFormat:
Implement connect(root). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: Return the original root after setting next pointers. The runner displays the values reached across each level.
